newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers offered up on crude, swaps.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers offered up on crude, swaps.

text.p: Singapore bunkers were quoted higher on Wednesday with shipowners sidelined following the big increase in the offered level.
Offers have risen by between $3-4 per tonne due to the large rise to crude prices and a firmer swaps market. An independent was offering 380-cst at $100 and 180-cst at $108.
March fuel oil swaps traded late Wednesday at $100.50 per tonne, up $2.00 from Tuesday.
Bunker 380-cst was quoted at $98-$100 per tonne and 180-cst at $106-$108. MDO and gas oil were quoted at $186-$188 and $198-$202 respectively. -- Singapore Newsroom (+65-870 3571)
